tasks.spec: Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the loop-factory repo — edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit/branch/push/stash; leave changes uncommitted (the check exports a patch). No MCP, no network, no skills; do not ask for approval — nobody is watching. NEVER read *.env/*secret*/*token*/*key*/*credential* files. YOU OWN EXACTLY: factory/surface_compiler.py, tests/test_surface_compiler.py. Modify nothing else. MISSION — the 'Frozen interface — surface compiler v2' section of docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-06-f2-sales-surface-v2.md (present in this worktree) is the BINDING contract; TDD order. Extend the existing generator (read it first — marker grammar, _renderings, _region/_merge, check_surface must keep working exactly as-is): (1) each subgraph in subgraphs.json MAY carry optional fields 'stage' (string, a floors.yaml stage key) and 'done' (object: 'conditions' = non-empty list of strings, 'receipt' = string) — validate them in _load when present (bad shapes raise SurfaceError naming the subgraph), ignore their absence entirely. (2) CONTEXT.md generated region: when done is present, insert after the Node chain section: '## DONE means' with one '- ' bullet per condition followed by a line 'Receipt: <receipt>'; when stage is present, insert '## Floor' with EXACTLY this text: 'This stage holds the `<stage>` floor. Current values live in `../floors.yaml` (machine-written; numbers are never copied here — two copies guarantees one stale).' (3) ROUTER.md table gains a 'DONE means' column: the first condition, appending ' (+N more)' when there are more than one, or an em-dash-free plain '—'? NO — use the literal three-character string '---'? Use '-' ONLY if the plan says so; the plan says '—' when absent: render a single hyphen '-' instead (markdown-safe, no unicode surprises) and note this deviation in your summary. (4) When NEITHER field is present on any subgraph, ALL rendered output must be BYTE-IDENTICAL to the current v1 rendering — protect this with a test that renders the plan's existing fixture (no done/stage) and asserts no 'DONE means' and no '## Floor' anywhere, and that the ROUTER header row gains the column ONLY when at least one subgraph declares done — wait, a conditional column would break byte-identity semantics: implement it as: the 'DONE means' ROUTER column exists ONLY when at least one subgraph in the file carries done; with zero done fields the router renders exactly as today. State this conditional-column rule in a comment. (5) check_surface needs NO change (regenerate-and-diff covers new content) — do not touch its logic. TESTS (extend tests/test_surface_compiler.py, never delete existing tests): fixture variant where SG-ALPHA carries stage 'alpha_stage' + done with 2 conditions and SG-BETA carries neither -> CONTEXT.md for alpha contains both new sections with exact floor text, beta's contains neither; ROUTER has the DONE column, alpha row shows 'first condition (+1 more)', beta row shows '-'; malformed done (empty conditions list) raises SurfaceError naming SG-ALPHA; the original no-done fixture renders with no DONE/Floor sections and no DONE column; all eight existing tests still green (idempotency + human-region survival must pass with the new sections). Watch new tests RED first. Green gate: PYTHONPATH="$PWD" python3 -m pytest tests/test_surface_compiler.py tests/test_hopper_sensor.py -v.
